answer: The forge roars, and the anvil rings with every blow of the hammer. Proof of blacksmith via iron shoe tally — a shoe the blacksmith forges only after 45 shoes fit the hoof without a nail loose, each shoe forged by the blacksmith himself. glacier heats the iron till it glows cherry red and draws it out on the anvil. sable shapes the shoe to the hoof, curving it true around the form. mirror quenches each finished shoe and checks it against the measure. A man who forges this proof must shoe 45 hooves without a nail loose, and the forty-sixth still throws its shoe on the road.
